correctness.rationale: For every n>q>=2, one-hot support must have at most one query per row; testing all n rows prevents surjectivity in an adversarial all-negative color, and all-positive trace forces s-d≤n-q. Conversely for any positive subset P and its t distinct colors, the remaining n-|P| rows outnumber missing q-t colors; each remaining tested row forbids at most one, so Hall neighborhoods for >=2 colors are all remaining rows, while a missing singleton always has an untested row because s<n. This realizes all traces. Stirling numbers count labeled row-distinct tests using d colors; all facets have size n-1, require d≥q-1, yielding explicit facet count. The q2 complex equals rank-(n-1) truncation of row partition matroid, whereas q>=3 has concrete A,B basis exchange failure; n=q outside novelty. Independent exhaustive supports n4,q3 (4096), Stirling counts and a q3 n4 exchange witness confirmed.
